meta.name: atlassian-mcp
meta.description: Integrates with Atlassian products to manage project tracking and documentation via MCP protocol. Use when querying Jira issues with JQL filters, creating and updating tickets with custom fields, searching or editing Confluence pages with CQL, managing sprints and backlogs, setting up MCP server authentication, syncing documentation, or debugging Atlassian API integrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 管理 Jira 项目和 Confluence 文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常用 Jira 和 Confluence 管理项目和文档
copy.tagline_en: Manage Jira projects and Confluence docs via MCP
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Jira and Confluence daily for project and doc management

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 MCP 连接 Atlassian 的 Jira 和 Confluence:按 JQL 查工单、建/改工单、管理迭代和待办,按 CQL 搜/改 Confluence 页面;还能设置服务器认证、同步文档、调试 API 对接,并给出配置与查询示例。
howto.when: 当你要用 JQL 查询 Jira 工单、用 CQL 搜索或编辑 Confluence 页面,或管理迭代与待办清单时触发;其他 Atlassian 集成需求(如设置认证)也会启用。

say.text: 用 JQL 找出当前迭代里分配给我的未完成工单
say.note: Claude 会用 Jira 查询并列出工单。

say.text: 在 Confluence 的 ENG 空间里搜索最近的部署手册
say.note: Claude 会用 CQL 搜索页面。

say.text: 把今天的会议纪要同步成一条新的 Jira 工单
say.note: Claude 会创建工单并填入纪要内容。

howto.what_en: Using MCP, Claude integrates with Atlassian Jira and Confluence: queries Jira via JQL, manages tickets/sprints/backlogs, searches Confluence via CQL, and handles auth setup, doc sync, and API debugging. Provides config and query examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when querying Jira with JQL, searching/editing Confluence with CQL, or managing sprints/backlogs; also for auth setup, doc sync, and API debugging.

say_en.text: Find open issues assigned to me in the current sprint using JQL.
say_en.note: Claude queries Jira and lists the issues.

say_en.text: Search the ENG space in Confluence for recent deployment runbooks.
say_en.note: Claude uses CQL to find pages.

say_en.text: Sync today's meeting notes into a new Jira ticket.
say_en.note: Claude creates a Jira ticket from the notes.
